description: React component for editing guardrail configurations, including form handling, provider-specific settings, and submission logic.

classes.name: EditGuardrailForm
classes.description: React functional component for editing guardrail configurations with form and modal UI.

methods.name: handleProviderChange
methods.description: Handles change of guardrail provider, resets provider-specific form fields and selections.

methods.name: handleEntitySelect
methods.description: Toggles selection of entities for PII configuration.

methods.name: handleActionSelect
methods.description: Sets the action for a specific entity in PII configuration.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Validates form, constructs guardrail data, and sends update request to backend.

methods.name: renderPiiConfiguration
methods.description: Renders PII configuration component if provider is PresidioPII.

methods.name: renderProviderSpecificFields
methods.description: Renders provider-specific configuration input fields based on selected provider.
